about: Rules for the cross-edition answer key of the twelve October 7, 2026 editions (tests/cross_edition.py). Stories of different editions are one event when they share a report; 'force' gives stories (by headline start) their own event, 'join' joins events that share no report but are one occurrence, 'related' pairs are different occurrences of one ongoing topic and are not scored. Hand-checked on October 8, 2026 from the shared-report clusters and every pair of events with two or more shared headline words.
